meta.title: Release platform v2.5 executable authority correction
meta.author: Codex release manager

feature.problem_statement: v2.5 corrects v2.4 invalid nonce and schema bindings, incomplete edge evidence, unsafe negative harnesses, and builder-generated council authority.
goals: Validate every positive and edge with Draft 2020-12.
Prove durable replay races and zero effects.
Keep live gates blocked until external council closure.
non_goals: Live GitHub, Vault, registry, Kubernetes or Argo mutation.
Treating an unsigned council template as authority.

perspectives.summary: Clean DAG and explicit pipeline stages are bound.
Live authority is rejected without complete identity evidence.
AP bootstrap objects are exact and workload ownership is outside app-config.
Negative and replay harnesses prove exact failures and zero effects.

council.consensus_summary: Pre-council corpus is reviewable; live activation remains blocked.
open_questions: External council must sign fixed manifest and report hashes.
